newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen mixed, focus on banks.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen mixed, focus on banks.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen mixed in slow trading on Friday, with the focus expected to be on Unibank and Bank BNI, brokers said.
BNI bank said in a statement on Thursday that it intends to purchase shares owned by Indonesia's central bank, Bank Indonesia, in N.V. De Indonesische Overzeese Bank (Indover) in Amsterdam.
"BNI is likely to remain active after the acquisition reports, but any possible upside is likely to be limited as Indover's financial details are little known here," one broker said.
Small-capitalised Unibank, scheduled to be listed on Friday, was also likely to attract attention following market talk that the bank's share offering was oversubscribed, another broker said.
Brokers said profit-taking was likely to continue in some blue-chips including Telkom, but speculative buying of some second-liners was likely to remain active.
On Thursday, the Jakarta composite index closed 1.56 points lower at 691.98 points. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
Ficorinvest was the third most active, with some four million shares traded due to renewed market talk that the central bank was also likely to sell its stake in Ficorinvest.
